subject: MetaCyc:SHIKIMATEDEG-PWY
description: Historical A. calcoaceticus LMD 79.41 context: Table 1 reports shikimate growth of the wild type and impaired growth of PQQ-biosynthesis mutants. The paragraph above Table 1 describes rescue by added PQQ, while Methods reports identification using API 20 NE. This context is distinct from ADP1 and does not assert modern retyping of the historical isolate or purification of its complete route.

evidence.source_assertion: Table 1 records shikimate growth for wild-type LMD 79.41, no shikimate growth for the PQQ-biosynthesis mutants M7, 82.43 and 1347, and delayed or weak growth for several mutants under the tested PQQ-free conditions.
evidence.source_locator: Authorized author reprint in the 1988 van Kleef dissertation: Chapter V, printed p. 85 (PDF page 94), Table 1, shikimate columns.
